prompt: A list of objects with timestamp (date-time) and text (non-empty), newest first.
notes: The schema represents an array of objects to store the corrections list. Each item is validated for a standard ISO 8601 date-time timestamp and a non-empty text string, ensuring high data quality without being overly restrictive.

schema.description: A list of published corrections, sorted newest first.

text.description: The description of what was corrected

timestamp.description: The date and time when the correction was published
